profile.primary_purpose: Position Taste as the infrastructure layer for AI taste and judgment, attract enterprise clients for model training and agent integration, and recruit technical and creative talent
profile.brand_signature: Dark, monochromatic design with stark contrast between deep blacks (#1e1e1e, #111) and off-white/cream (#f5f7f2) sections. Bold, modern typography combining Matter sans-serif with Azeret Mono for technical credibility. Animated 3D card carousels, Lottie animations, and interactive elements create a sophisticated, research-lab aesthetic.

visual_language.accent_strategy: Minimal accent color use; relies primarily on high contrast between black backgrounds and white/cream text with subtle grey (#8b8b8b) for secondary content. Occasional blue (#002bba) appears in interactive elements.
visual_language.highlights: 3D rotating card carousels, Lottie SVG animations for mission visualization, draggable team marquee, and interactive swipe-based footer game create dynamic focal points against static dark backgrounds

target_audience: AI/ML engineers and researchers seeking infrastructure solutions for subjective domain evaluation in model training
Enterprise product teams building AI agents or applications that require aesthetic judgment and brand consistency
Technical and creative professionals considering careers at the intersection of AI and design/taste evaluation
strategy.executive_synthesis: Taste's visual identity deliberately positions the company as a serious research institution rather than a typical startup, using monochromatic palettes and technical typography to signal credibility in the nascent field of AI taste infrastructure. The dark, lab-like aesthetic reinforces their mission to 'end AI slop' by visually demonstrating sophisticated judgment. Interactive elements (3D carousels, swipe interfaces) serve dual purposes: showcasing product capabilities while engaging visitors in the core value proposition of subjective evaluation. The prominent careers section and team photography humanize the technical mission, targeting both enterprise buyers and talent simultaneously.

style_classification.reasoning: The design exhibits clear Brutalist characteristics with a modern tech company execution. The most distinctive element is the raw, default web blue (#0000EE) used for links - this is the unmistakable "Brutalist Hyperlink Aesthetic" that directly references unstyled HTML hyperlinks, creating a deliberately raw, technical, and anti-polished feel. The color palette is severely restricted to monochromatic blacks (#1E1E1E, #111111, #121212) and whites (#F5F7F2, #FFFFFF), with stark structural inversions between dark and light sections. Typography uses Azeret Semimono (a semi-monospace font) for headlines and UI elements, reinforcing the code-centric, technical aesthetic typical of digital Brutalism. The layout features generous whitespace and centered symmetric compositions, but the raw material honesty comes through in the high-contrast color blocking, minimal decoration, and the unpolished quality of using system-default blue. The 3D elements in the hero add visual interest but don't override the fundamentally stark, stripped-back approach. Scoring on the 6 spectra: Visual Density is Airy/Spacious (generous 9rem vertical padding); Color Cleanliness is Clean/Pure (monochromatic grayscale with one stark accent); Chronology is Modern/Contemporary; Dimensionality is primarily Flat with 3D illustration accents; Decoration is Minimal (no ornamental patterns, raw typography); Structure is Rigid Grid (12-column system, centered layouts).
style_classification.reasoning_secondary: Corporate modifier applies because despite the Brutalist raw aesthetic, the site serves a legitimate tech/AI infrastructure company with professional polish. The generous whitespace, clean hierarchy, clear navigation, job listings section, and research/blog content all signal corporate credibility and trustworthiness. The design balances Brutalist edge (raw hyperlink blue, monospace fonts, stark contrasts) with Corporate professionalism (clean typography hierarchy, systematic spacing, polished 3D illustrations). This creates a "tech-forward startup" aesthetic that says "we're serious engineers who don't need decorative polish" while still maintaining professional credibility for enterprise clients.

layout.section_separation: Sections alternate between deep black (#1e1e1e), off-white/cream (#f5f7f2), pure white, and extra-dark black (#111). Transitions use gradient overlays (hero-bg, api-gradient) and generous vertical padding (9rem desktop, 4rem mobile). Horizontal strokes with gray opacity separate content blocks within sections. Navigation color transitions (nav-black-to-white, nav-white-to-dark-black) create visual continuity across color-block sections.

insights: High-contrast color blocking (black/white/cream) creates bold section rhythm; each major section is a distinct color zone with deliberate palette shifts.
Generous vertical spacing (9rem default desktop padding) and centered layouts emphasize breathing room and hierarchy; mobile collapses to 4rem padding with stacked layouts.

Interactive 3D elements (carousel, draggable marquee, card swiper footer) add depth and engagement while maintaining clean, minimal structure; Lottie animations and GSAP transitions enhance cinematic feel.
Typography scale uses fluid clamp() for responsive sizing (global-headline-l: 2.5rem → 4rem); Azeret Semimono for UI, Matter for body, creating a modern, technical aesthetic.
Grid system is flexible: strict 12-column for desktop, collapses to single-column mobile, with intermediate 8-column tablet; custom 24-column grid available for fine-grained layouts.

insights: Brutalist Hyperlink Aesthetic: The bold, unadulterated #0000EE directly references default web hyperlinks, giving the brand a raw, technical, and engineer-focused feel that aligns with an API product.

Structural Inversion: The palette is built on stark reversals; the core black and paper white constantly swap roles between background and ink depending on the section (e.g., Dark Hero vs. Light Mission).

Monochromatic Restraint: By restricting the design to grayscales and one stark accent, the interface strips away subjectivity, fitting the brand's narrative of being a fundamental "infra layer" for AI.

labels.description: Label styles are smaller, utilitarian styles, used for things like the text inside components or for very small text in the content body, such as captions.

others.description: Font that does not have a classifier, that is small like regular.

insights: The brand identity is heavily influenced by monospace and semi-monospace fonts (Azeret Semimono, Azeret Mono), giving it a distinct technical, AI-centric aesthetic.
Fluid typography is implemented extensively using CSS clamp(), allowing headings, body text, and even UI labels to scale seamlessly across viewports.
Matter is used as the primary workhorse sans-serif for high legibility in body copy and core headings, contrasting with the monospace elements used for data and UI accents.

assets.asset_description: An exploded smartwatch interface shows a central black screen surrounded by colorful, patterned watch faces on a dark background.
A white geometric emblem on a black background, with a rounded square centered inside a rounded diamond shape.
Black graphic with a central rounded-square badge reading “The Brand API Demo,” surrounded by symmetrical cream geometric motifs.
Black title card reading “AI Engineer, RLE & Evals” in white sans-serif text, framed by thin copper geometric curves.
Abstract geometric artwork with a bold cream numeral 1 on a vivid green field, beside dark triangular panels and diagonal cream stripes.
Dark recruitment graphic for a Full-time AI-Engineer, Full Stack role, with a bold centered headline above four rounded portfolio panels.
A dark honeycomb grid displays colorful design tiles, including geometric artwork, a purple statistics panel, red repeating typography, and a blue “orchids” tile.
A curved Nasdaq billboard in a glass skyscraper displays bold white “TASTE” lettering beneath a black-and-neon-green Disruptors ad.
Black-and-cream AI-Engineer job poster with mirrored hourglass curves, monospaced text, and a vivid yellow lower panel.
A dark comparison graphic shows website mockups labeled “Original,” “Without,” and “With the Brand API,” with green accents and overlapping pricing cards.
A curved Nasdaq billboard in a city plaza displays bold white “DISRUPTORS” and “TASTE” text with bright green “60.AI” lettering.
